rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only candidate must preserve valid completion before lap-time gains count.
observable_information: Four grayscale frames, road-edge clearance, road-center motion, visible obstacles, rendered HUD speed, and fixed stable actor action.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Compare four activated stable-base mechanisms without parameter sweeps: clearance speed floor, bend exit burst, obstacle preview brake, and mild-bend outer entry.
expected_success_endpoint: At least the selected control's finish count in twelve fresh matched TUNE cells, followed by a lower median finished lap time with no invalid actions.
control: Exact-hash selected full-road-guard actor on each registered cell.
falsifier: Any lower finish count than control, invalid action, or tied completion without lower median finished lap time.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Tracks 1–3 × seeds 324–327, one control and four independent candidates, 60 episodes with 2000 decisions per episode.
resource_and_risk_gate: Linux Python 3.11 CPU and registered 1800-second limit; 328–331 reserved held-out, no confirmation, blind, package, upload, or submission.
